description: Update a specific entry by its ID. Only provided fields are updated.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Updated entry result with keys: entry (the updated entry record), message (confirmation)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Updates specific fields of an existing entry by its ID, only modifying fields that are explicitly provided
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: no entry exists with the given ID. ValidationError: invalid field values provided. NoChangesError: no fields were provided to update.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found: use 'resolve' on the parent address to get valid entry IDs. For validation errors: check the field values are valid strings. For no changes: provide at least one of field_type, description, or value.
